name: Ambrose Quill
description: A retired schoolteacher who insists his presence in purgatory is a clerical error, and has taken it upon himself to alphabetize the town's case files while he waits for it to be corrected.
idle_dialogue: Ah, hello! Mind the stack by your foot. That's the letter M, and it is delicate.
I've filed every complaint this town has ever made. There are a great many about the fountain.
There's been a clerical error, you know. I'm certain it will be sorted out any day now.
